status: Frozen reconstruction choices before execution; not recovered original scripts
classification: Retrospective development-cohort comparison, not external validation or a full-paper replication
headline: Saved non-LDM dense global H12, equal-client FedAdam, 12 rounds, 2 local epochs; no H12 retraining

wang.baseline: First 100 train+calibration acquisitions if at least 100 exist; otherwise first min(30, history length). Never use held-out healthy rows to fit a threshold.

project.reference: max rolling 13th-largest score over 21 training+calibration acquisitions

gev.block_order: chronological within regime, include final partial block
gev.short_or_invalid_fit: 0.995 empirical baseline quantile if fewer than 3 block maxima, degenerate maxima, or invalid fitted quantile; record every fallback

javanmardi.onset: first label unequal to healthy_label at index >= tolerance
javanmardi.alarm: step held true from onset, masked through calibration; no reset at fault boundary
unrecovered: whether transition is a held alarm
javanmardi.causality: retrospective full-trajectory clustering, unlike the frozen causal project detector

loges.processing: per channel: demean, Hilbert envelope, demean envelope, unnormalised rFFT magnitude, include 0..5000 Hz, mean-pool 256 equal index intervals, log1p; elementwise maximum across the two vibration channels
loges.normalisation: per-bin training mean and population std, replace std <= 1e-8 by 1

ae.initialisation: independent normal weights std sqrt(2/(256+32)), zero biases
ae.score: mean squared reconstruction error in standardised logES space

unrecovered: FFT scaling and exact rebin convention
AE optimiser, training duration, initialisation, seed
loges.deviation_from_paper: plain dense AE instead of VAE

selection_policy: No tuning to recover logged counts. All fixed cells and seeds saved, including failures and GEV fallbacks.
